Container.Name: openportrait
Container.Overview: OpenPortrait is a self-hosted studio CRM for photographers: leads, shoots, calendar, booking pages, quotes and orders, contracts, and client galleries, all in one container. It includes a built-in Cloudflare Tunnel so clients can reach your galleries and booking pages without opening ports.[br][br]After installing, open the WebUI and follow the setup screen. Settings > Internet access walks you through connecting your domain.
Container.Requires: A domain on Cloudflare is recommended so clients can reach galleries and booking pages from the internet. See Settings > Internet access after install.

Config.Name: WebUI port
Config.Description: Port for the OpenPortrait web interface.

Config.Name: App data
Config.Description: Database, encryption key and nightly backups. Keep this on a share that is backed up.

Config.Name: Galleries
Config.Description: Your photo share. Each shoot gets a folder here, with Originals/RAW and Gallery (the delivered photos) inside.

Config.Name: Incoming
Config.Description: Photos sent straight from the camera (SFTP/FTP) wait here until you sort them into a shoot.

Config.Name: Cache
Config.Description: Generated previews and thumbnails. Safe to delete; a cache pool is ideal.

Config.Name: Cloudflare Tunnel token
Config.Description: Optional. Starts the built-in Cloudflare Tunnel. You can also paste it later in Settings > Internet access, which walks you through getting one.

Config.Name: Public URL
Config.Description: Optional. Your public address, for example https://studio.example.com. Filled in from the tunnel when left empty.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User id that owns files OpenPortrait writes. 99 is Unraid's nobody.

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group id for files OpenPortrait writes. 100 is Unraid's users group.

Config.Name: UMASK
Config.Description: Permission mask for new files. Use 002 to let the users group write too.

Config.Name: Log level
Config.Description: fatal, error, warn, info, debug or trace.

Config.Name: Folder rescan (minutes)
Config.Description: How often the galleries share is rescanned as a backstop for missed file events.

Config.Name: Platform
Config.Description: Tells OpenPortrait it runs on Unraid so its guides match. Leave as is.
